channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump considers giving away part of Yosemite to private company
item.description: The Trump administration is eyeing a land swap that would give part of Yosemite National Park to a private company, according to a document submitted to Congress. In the document, obtained by The Hill, the National Park Service (NPS) states that a landowner is seeking to connect their property with a park service road in [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] SpaceX recovers Starship from the Indian Ocean a month after launch and is shipping it back to Texas
item.description: SpaceX has pulled off its biggest salvage operation yet, recovering its most recently launched Starship from the Indian Ocean.

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump can’t appeal New York conviction in federal court, judge rules again
item.description: A federal judge on Friday rejected President Trump’s latest bid to fight his criminal conviction outside of New York’s state courts, a strategy aimed at citing presidential immunity, under which Trump could potentially toss charges that stem from a 2016 hush money payment in the trash can. U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein has denied Trump’s attempts to move to federal court three [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Warsh indicates Fed could raise rates to cool inflation
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh signaled on Friday the Federal Reserve is not ruling out an interest rate hike as inflation remains too high. "We must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed. Otherwise, we have work to do," Warsh said in a speech at the Fed's [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Gallishaw sentenced to life in deadly sexual Tampa encounter: SAO
item.description: Dewayne Gallishaw will spend the rest of his life behind bars, the Hillsborough County State Attorney’s Office, 13th Judicial Circuit, said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for Aug. 28
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Chief Meteorologist Denis Phillips gives Florida's most accurate forecast.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump announces deal to secure billions of barrels of Venezuelan oil for the US
item.description: President Donald Trump said Friday the U.S. would take majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves in Venezuela. He did not immediately give more details.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Push to rename Nashville airport for Dolly Parton gets a boost from Tennessee's governor
item.description: Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee and the CEO of the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority both came out in favor of the name change Friday. It's expected to come up at the authority's meeting next month.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man arrested for cutting down old oak tree involved in fatal crash: VPD
item.description: A Sarasota man was arrested by police on Thursday after cutting down a mature oak tree involved at fatal crash site at Patriots Park, officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lakeland rancher says Trump’s beef tariff plan comes at worst possible time
item.description: President Donald Trump has signed a proclamation temporarily lowering tariffs on certain foreign beef imports to bring down beef prices for American consumers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] States can regulate prediction markets as gambling, federal appeals court rules
item.description: A federal appeals court ruled Friday that states can regulate prediction markets like gambling, dealing a major blow to the booming industry.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge rules Fla. Department of Corrections' seizure of prisoner's civil rights settlement violated federal law
item.description: A Pasco County man won a $60,000 settlement after officers beat him, leaving him blind in one eye. The state later took the money and sought more than $547,000 under Florida’s “pay-to-stay” law.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bartow police chief resigns; internal affairs investigation launched after complaint by employee: Officials
item.description: The Bartow City Manager said an employee filed a complaint against then-Police Chief Walker, and an inquiry found the allegations credible.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wesley Chapel Cobalt Apartments fire sparks safety questions, push to change Pasco County building codes
item.description: A Wesley Chapel apartment fire is raising safety questions and sparking a push to change Pasco County building codes for sprinklers and lightning rods.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Chopped' Chef Will Artley dazzles at Clearwater Beach Sheraton resort at Sand Key
item.description: "Chopped" Chef Will Artley dazzles at Clearwater Beach Sheraton Resort at Sand Key. This former White House chef now runs a scratch kitchen out of the local hotel.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man posing as San Francisco 49ers player charged with defrauding dozens of women
item.description: Two men have been charged with conspiracy to commit wire fraud and wire fraud after posing as NFL players.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Manatee County man charged with murder after father dies from injuries: MCSO
item.description: A Manatee County man is facing a murder charge after deputies say his 85-year-old father died from injuries suffered during a fight earlier this month, according to the Manatee Co. Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Brooklyn Haitian restaurant owner says the end of TPS is 'worse than COVID' for business
item.description: Wesly Simon, who owns a popular Haitian restaurant in Brooklyn's Little Caribbean neighborhood, told Scripps News he was forced to fire longtime workers after protections for Haitian immigrants ended.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 64 percent of online shoppers are using AI to help find products, study shows
item.description: A new Ryder study has found that 64 percent of online shoppers are using AI tools to help find and compare products prior to purchase.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] TPD: Ybor Heights shooting that left 2 dead ruled murder-suicide
item.description: Tampa police said a deadly shooting earlier this month in the Ybor Heights neighborhood has been classified as a murder-suicide, according to a news release.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tipping fatigue getting to you? This survey says you're not alone
item.description: U.S. consumers are cutting back on gratuities or skipping them altogether, according to a recent survey.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 2 workers at Germany's Frankfurt Airport die from what is known as 'airport malaria'
item.description: Two workers at Germany’s Frankfurt Airport have died after contracting malaria believed to have been spread by a mosquito brought into the country via an aircraft.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two Georgia women sentenced in fraud scheme, stealing millions from Amazon
item.description: Two Georgia women have been sentenced in a fraud scheme in which prosecutors say they stole close to $10 million from Amazon.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fired Stars and Stripes journalists accuse Pentagon of retaliation
item.description: A new lawsuit says Defense Department officials punished staffers for public comments and coverage of Navy ship conditions.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa man hit, killed by tractor-trailer trying to cross U.S. 41
item.description: Tampa man was killed in Hillsborough County on Friday after he was hit by a tractor-trailer trying to cross U.S. Highway 41, authorities said.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County commissioners vote 5-2 to approve Rays' Tampa stadium funding
item.description: The Hillsborough County Board of County Commissioners voted 5-2 on Friday to approve the development and funding agreement for the Tampa Bay Rays' proposed new ballpark at Hillsborough College.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Crews begin removing Confederate statues from Virginia's Capitol Square
item.description: Crews could be seen working to remove three Confederate-linked statues from Virginia's Capitol Square on Friday morning after a state senator introduced legislation to remove them earlier this year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Prediction market Kalshi partners with The Weather Company on climate trading
item.description: Kalshi is expanding it's reach once again. The company has announced it's joining forces with The Weather Company in an effort to expand the weather trading business.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] McDonald’s bringing back Spicy Chicken McNuggets for limited time
item.description: McDonald’s is reviving its Spicy Chicken McNuggets, which sold out in two weeks when they debuted in 2020.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] North Carolina teen critically ill after contracting infection from brain-eating amoeba
item.description: A teen in central North Carolina is critically ill after contracting a rare brain-eating amoeba found in bodies of warm freshwater, according to state health officials.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Updated COVID-19 shots cleared as health groups urge vaccination
item.description: Updated COVID-19 vaccines targeting the XFG variant have been approved by the FDA for older adults and others at high risk.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with sexual battery on 4-year-old girl in St. Petersburg: SPPD
item.description: The St. Petersburg Police Department (SPPD) has charged a 26-year-old man with sexually abusing a 4-year-old child, the department said Friday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Rays stadium deal: Hillsborough College prepares for major upgrades
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays may be getting a new home, but the team will not be the only part of the area getting a major makeover.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Former Hillsborough substitute teacher sentenced for sexual misconduct with student
item.description: A former substitute teacher in Hillsborough County was sentenced to 10 years in prison Friday for sexual misconduct with a student.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 21 dachshunds recovering at Humane Society of Tampa Bay, rescued from hoarding situation
item.description: The Humane Society of Tampa Bay (HSTB) took in 21 dachshunds following a hoarding situation.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Two boats catch fire at Davis Islands Yacht Club in Tampa
item.description: Two boats caught on fire at the Davis Islands Yacht Club on Friday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pinellas County chase: Driver crashes on I-275 after fleeing troopers
item.description: A suspect caught on dashcam weaving through I-275 traffic in Pinellas County while trying to avoid troopers was arrested after crashing into another car.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man charged with child sexual abuse in St. Petersburg investigation
item.description: A 26-year-old man faces charges after a young child reported being sexually abused, according to the St. Petersburg Police Department.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] North Port DUI arrest: Sleeping driver caught on U.S. 41
item.description: Police arrested a driver in North Port after officers discovered him asleep behind the wheel on U.S. 41 after he drank too much alcohol.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Fleet Force CDL training Manatee County: Program hits 10,000th graduate mark
item.description: A Manatee County truck driving program works to expand training efforts to address a nationwide commercial driver shortage expected to top 1.1 million positions over the next decade.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manatee County son charged in father's murder after fight turns deadly
item.description: A 51-year-old man faces a second-degree murder charge after his father died from injuries sustained during a physical fight at a home in Manatee County, according to the Manatee County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Bartow police chief resignation: Internal affairs investigation launched
item.description: Bartow Police Chief Stephen Walker stepped down from his role and is now under investigation following an employee complaint.
